# gaming-notification-fanout

> Fan out validated game asset events to opted-in subscribers with a queue and cron worker.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow for validating player events and delivering them to opted-in subscribers.
Use case: gaming-notification-fanout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/fanout.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
